paragraphs.text: The story of the Gatewatch was mapped out in the Bolas Arc . This allowed the writers to weave in some visions and prophecies that would come true in later chapters. It is expected that eventually all elements of the prophecies will come about.
On Amonkhet , Nissa Revane experienced several visions sent by Kefnet in The Hand that Moves .
